languageDescription: Select a language to continue. You can change it later.
languageSaveFailed: Language changed here, but your account preference could not be saved.
assistantDescription: Translate general oral-health information or prepare simple patient instructions.
chatbotDescription: Ask a general oral-health education question in your selected language.
chatbotPrivacyNotice: Messages are sent to Google Gemini. Do not enter names, mobile numbers, patient IDs, images, or personal health records. Patient images are never sent.
chatbotDisclaimer: Demonstration only: answers may be wrong and cannot diagnose or recommend treatment. Seek a qualified clinician for personal concerns. Medical responses in regional languages need clinician review before real-world use.
chatbotUnavailable: The Gemini chatbot is not configured. Ask an administrator to configure the server.
chatbotError: The chatbot could not respond. Try again later or ask a qualified clinician.
chatbotPrivateError: Remove names, contact details, and patient IDs. Do not share personal health records.
translationDisclaimer: AI-assisted translation. Medical translations must be reviewed by qualified clinicians before real-world deployment.
translationError: Translation is unavailable. Try again or ask a qualified clinician for help.
voiceDescription: Speak or type. You can always use the text box if voice is unavailable.
voiceRecordingPrivacy: When you stop recording, the audio is sent to the server speech provider or Gemini for transcription. Do not speak names, contact details, patient IDs, or private health records.
voiceRecordingUnavailable: Audio recording is unavailable in this browser or page. Use a secure HTTPS/localhost page and type your message if needed.
voiceRecordingFailed: The recording could not be started or saved. Check microphone access and try again, or type your message.
voiceTranscriptionUnavailable: Server transcription is not configured. Try browser voice dictation if available or type your message.
voiceTranscriptionFailed: Your recording could not be transcribed. Check your connection and Gemini configuration, then try again or type your message.
voiceQuotaExceeded: Gemini request quota was reached. Try again later or type your message.
voiceGeminiKeyFailed: The server Gemini API key was rejected. Ask an administrator to verify the server configuration.
voiceGeminiModelFailed: The configured Gemini model is unavailable for speech transcription. Ask an administrator to select an enabled model.
geminiVoiceDescription: Ask a general oral-health education question by voice or text. Gemini replies in your selected language, and your device reads the answer aloud.
geminiVoiceMode: Turn-by-turn voice support using Gemini chat and browser speech services. This is not real-time Gemini Live streaming. Answers are educational only, not a diagnosis or treatment.
voiceInstructions: Choose a language, then use the microphone to speak. Your words appear as text; review them before using.
patientDictationNotice: Voice dictation may use your browser's speech service. Only dictate synthetic demo information; check every word before saving. Numeric fields must be entered manually.
voiceUnavailable: Speech recognition is not available in this browser. Type your message instead.
voicePermissionDenied: Microphone permission was denied. Type your message instead.
voiceMicrophoneUnavailable: No microphone is available. Connect a microphone or type your message.
voiceNetworkError: Speech recognition could not connect to the browser speech service. Check your connection or type your message.
voiceNoSpeech: No speech was detected. Check your microphone and try again, or type your message.
voiceRecognitionFailed: Speech could not be recognized. Try again or type your message.
voiceTextFallback: Odia voice support may be limited in this browser. Text input is always available.
voiceActionsHint: Type or record words first. Read aloud and Clear text need text; Stop audio is available while playback is active.
speechUnavailable: Speech playback is unavailable. Please read the text.
whatsappPrefilledMessage: Hello, I need help with Aarogya Drishti.

serverErrors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Check the entered information and try again.
serverErrors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
serverErrors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again later.
serverErrors.TRANSLATION_RATE_LIMITED: Translation request limit reached. Try again later.
serverErrors.TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE: This phrase is not available offline and no translation service is configured.
serverErrors.CHATBOT_INPUT_PRIVATE: Remove names, contact details, and patient IDs before sending.
serverErrors.CHATBOT_UNAVAILABLE: The Gemini chatbot is not configured on the server.
serverErrors.CHATBOT_PROVIDER_FAILED: The chatbot provider could not complete this request.
serverErrors.CHATBOT_PROVIDER_INVALID_RESPONSE: The chatbot provider returned an invalid response.
serverErrors.CHATBOT_TIMEOUT: The chatbot did not respond in time.
serverErrors.SERVER_STT_UNAVAILABLE: Server speech recognition is not configured. Use browser speech recognition or type your message.
serverErrors.GEMINI_STT_TIMEOUT: Gemini speech recognition timed out. Try again or type your message.
serverErrors.GEMINI_STT_FAILED: Gemini speech recognition could not complete. Check the server and API key, then try again.
serverErrors.GEMINI_AUTH_FAILED: The configured Gemini API key was rejected.
serverErrors.GEMINI_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The configured Gemini model is unavailable.
serverErrors.GEMINI_STT_INVALID_RESPONSE: Gemini did not return a transcript. Try again or type your message.
